shape.description: Orange open-frame tower, one cell square, two tiers: a top dished cup taking marbles from all four sides, with four small corner pegs that hold a piece stacked above, and a bottom cup with exits on two opposite sides and a ridge that sends a marble one way or the other. Arched block feet.
shape.sizeBasis: Not photographed. Taken from the T-Rex M-04 photo ratio (rim about 1.6 widths high) and one cell wide; same tower shape in lp manual p5.

physics.behaviour: Two-tier splitter. A marble comes in from any of the four sides of the top tier, drops through to the bottom tier and leaves by one of two opposite sides, at random each time. Passive; gravity only.

evidence.source: lp_plans_06 step 3-6 and crop of it
evidence.shows: Placement 1: M-04 on a 3-block stack. T-06 leaves its waist level, level with z 4, toward the tower that carries T-01.
Same placement: a second T-06 runs the other way from the seat of the block under M-04 (z 3) to the B-04 at z 3. This line passes under the feet of M-04.
Same placement: T-03 from the top of a 5-block tower enters at about z 5, the upper level.
Same placement: M-05 stands on top, so its hole drops into the heart-shaped hole.
Placement 2: M-04 on B-03. Dark red arrows run in line through M-04 and along T-07 to a B-03 tower. Step 2-8 puts the spiral funnel M-15 above it.
Placement 3: T-04 enters (arrow toward M-04) and T-03 leaves west, then a B-01, then T-06 south.
Placement 4: T-04 from a B-02 arrives (arrow), T-08 leaves near waist level to a B-01.
Placement 5: T-11 arrives; an arrow leaves under M-04 toward lower left along the block below.
Part named M-04 with label 5 on the frame.
T-Rex set also lists M-04, count 2. Same code; check whether it is the same mould.
Marbles come in from any of four directions on the top tier and fall to the bottom; one M-04 kind sends them randomly one way or the other, the other has a toggle that alternates sides

assumptions: Which set has the random splitter: by elimination, since the photographed T-Rex M-04 has the alternating flap. Not confirmed by Joey.
Bottom exits on two opposite sides (E and W); top tier takes all four sides. Matches Level 3 use: T-03 in at the upper level, T-06 out at the lower one (lp_plans_06, lp_plans_10).
Height 2 slots: M-05 on M-04 is level with the T-06 from the rocket port, which needs M-05's seat at z 6 with M-04's feet at z 3.
Filename carries __5422 because T-Rex uses the same code.

marblePaths list the four ways into the E exit (straight through, from either side, and back out the side it came in). The W exit takes the same four, mirrored: the tower is the same turned half round, so the engine turns it instead of listing them twice.
